messages:
sasha: FYI ran the FP8 canary across H100/L40S matrix for atlas-13b long-context tests. Observed consistent PPL spike on L40S for sequences >2k when FP8 kernels were combined with AWQ/GPTQ quantized weights.

mohit: spike meaning how much? 5-10%? any qualitative degradation?

sasha: median PPL +9%, tail samples show token repeats and coherence loss. perf numbers OK. Only reproducible when fp8 kernel + int8-like quant tables used together.

claire: was KV tiling on? L40S has different tiling heuristics.

sasha: tiling=auto. rerun with tiling=off and regression disappears on L40S. H100 unchanged either way.

ken: that smells like handshake/tiling offset impacting scale propagation. fp8 pre/post scaling semantics changed between kernel versions.

qa-runner: canary-bot: summary for 1753456789

canary-bot: metrics: model=atlas-13b, trials=1,200; H100(fp8)=baseline ±1.2% PPL; L40S(fp8,tiling=auto)=median +9.1% PPL; L40S(fp8,tiling=off)=+0.8% PPL. failing slices: longprefix, codegen >2048 tokens.

claire: paste the exact invoke flags/envs

sasha: 
```
run_canary --model atlas-13b \n  --quant awq --kernel fp8 --tiling auto \n  --longctx 4096 --dataset longprefix_set \n  --kv-cache true --fp8-autorescale=on
```

mohit: try --fp8-autorescale=off and --fp8-legacy-scale to emulate L40S older semantics.

sasha: autorescale=off -> delta reduced to +2.5% PPL. legacy-scale -> regression gone.

ken: indicates per-tensor vs per-channel scale mismatch. L40S kernel likely defaulted to legacy per-tensor for some ops.

claire: plan: 1) reproduce minimal repro script, 2) run legacy vs per-channel scale flags, 3) dump activation min/max and scale traces for KV projection and attn out, 4) test quant variants (awq/gptq/int8-only).

sasha: uploaded trimmed traces (base64) and range dumps: kv_q_min [-0.12,-0.14,...], kv_q_max [0.11,0.13,...]

mohit: I'll add per-channel scale logging and a runtime check to gate fp8 kernel selection when scale mismatch >1.5x across adjacent layers.

claire: add canary routing fallback: if regression > threshold, route L40S traffic to fp32 fallback.

ken: also audit tiling offset math for kv cache eviction alignment; mixing tiling and handshake could reorder blocks causing mismatched scaling boundaries.

sasha: pausing fp8 rollout to L40S and exposing tiling=off as temporary unlock in canary policy.

mohit: will run 24h shadow comparing legacy-scale L40S vs per-channel H100 and collect eval deltas.

claire: assign: mohit -> implement logging + legacy flag test; ken -> review tiling/handshake code on L40S; sasha -> update canary policy + infra ticket.

canary-bot: created INF-3492 "fp8-l40s-tiling-scale-mismatch"; 24h shadow run scheduled.

ken: ping me when logs are live, I'll prepare hotfix branch if handshake isolation is possible.

sasha: thanks all. will sanitize and post concrete prompt/output examples in thread.

mohit: quick q — should we try INT8-only AWQ build to see if fp8 kernels interact poorly with mixed-precision quant tables?

claire: yes. run matrix: {fp8 on/off} x {tiling auto/off} x {quant awq/gptq/int8} x {H100/L40S}.

sasha: spinning up matrix job, ETA ~3h for first wave. will update thread.

claire: thanks :+1:
